_doc: Single-variable candidate: R2 idle head tilt16 ->8 degrees, DESIGN3.5 range5-10. All mesh edits, circlet, pose/bust/hand settings, Q/back and finish remain R2. Unrendered, unpromoted; delivery owns exclusive Blender proof.

why.tabard: Critics (first impression, body, outfit): the pelvis read as one skin block with a 1 px string ('bottomless'), and the thin pointed tabard read as a sword. The design's front tabard is meant to cover the front (DESIGN table: 'covers the front, main flag'): widened x1.3 at the waist to x1.65 at the hem (a flare, silhouette mass) and hung straight (idle tabard g 1.0, no side wind), so it covers the crotch at 144 and 80.
why.circlet: Critic (head and hair): 'no signature priestess head piece; the side beads are tiny; add a gold circlet, rosace pin or short veil that reads at 80'. A gold front diadem on the hair's own contour at the brow (front 1.775 m, back 1.845 m, 160 deg arc whose ends sink into the hair) with a glass rosace jewel at the centre. A full ring read as a hat brim; a band 0.02 m tall drew as outline only.
why.idle: Pose angles +30 % over the figure-pose lane's concept A (ESCALATION 1): hip rotation 5/15/4 -> 6.5/19.5/5.2, torso bend -12/-5 -> -15.6/-6.5, upper chest lift 6 -> 8, head tilt 12 -> 16 and chin 7 -> 10 (critic: 'tilt 6-8 deg chin down, knowing look'). The near bell sleeve is scaled 0.78 and blown back (g 0.5) so the waist-to-hip curve breaks the silhouette (critic: 'clear the sleeve off the hip'). The free knee's pole moves out-forward (the stance note: 'idle knees cross inward').
why.back: Critic: 'not a back view: a near-frontal face'. The look amount 1.0 -> 0.62 with max 85 -> 60: the head turns over the shoulder to three-quarter (head facing the camera 0.78 -> 0.44), and d9_post draws one profile eye when the far eye faces away (r2_faces.json profile_below).
why.q: Critic (first impression): 'the q crouch reads as a broken hip / a fall at 80'. The kicked-up rear leg drops into a driving back lunge (foot 0.64 -> 0.32 m high, knee pole down) and the camera turns 50 -> 35 deg so the rear leg reads behind her instead of splayed sideways. The stamp itself (planted glaive, front heel) is unchanged.
why.hand: Critics (body 6, grip 8): 'the free hand is a clump at the sternum; move it to the hip, back of the wrist on the hip bone, elbow out'. The figure-pose lane's rest-frame wrist [-0.15, 0, 1.22] lands in front of the belly in the 45 deg view, under the cuff. Moved to [-0.21, 0.09, 1.10] (out, back and down onto the side of the hip) with the elbow pole out-back [-0.9, 1.0, 1.3]: the hand now sits on the silhouette's hip with the forearm and waist framing a gap (trials r2_vd / r2_ve, ve kept).
